dedupe_keys.name: caida anonymized internet traces equinix chicago san jose and new york monitors 2008 to 2019

description: The CAIDA Anonymized Internet Traces dataset contains anonymised passive traffic traces from CAIDA's high-speed monitors on internet backbone links at Equinix exchange sites, from April 2008 to January 2019. Traces from 2008 to 2014 come from the equinix-chicago and equinix-sanjose monitors, 2015 and 2016 from equinix-chicago, and from 2018 from equinix-nyc. The first trace is a one-hour capture during the Day in the Life of the Internet event of March 2008 on one direction of an OC192 link; monthly bidirectional one-hour traces followed, each of the order of 80 GB of compressed pcap. Coverage: a few backbone links at US exchange sites, monthly one-hour samples, 2008 to 2019. Format and access: anonymised pcap packet headers, free to academic and government researchers after a request and acceptable use agreement with CAIDA. Caveats: no payloads; IP addresses anonymised with prefix preservation; the series ended in 2019; only one-hour samples. Simulation uses: traffic mix and volume on backbone links for capacity planning and for training anomaly detectors in resilience studies. Related records: data-mawi-wide-backbone-traffic-archive gives a longer Japanese series; data-caida-ucsd-network-telescope gives unsolicited traffic.
